shell_commands: ls scripts/ scripts/spec-links/ 2>/dev/null; ls .claude 2>/dev/null; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -name "*.mjs" -print 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E "re-lint|lint" | head -20
grep -n "PromptBuilderConfig" -A 30 src/infrastructure/builders/promptBuilder.ts | head -60; echo ---; grep -rn "new PromptBuilder" src --include="*.ts" | grep -v node_modules | head
grep -n "max-expects\|require-spec-link\|require-status-matches-coverage" eslint.config.mjs | head; echo ---; grep -n '"spec:names\|check:spec-links\|repoint' package.json

grep -n "trailing\|misplaced\|findMisplaced" node_modules/@re-cinq/eslint-plugin-re-lint/dist/rules/lib/spec-link-index.mjs | head; echo ----; grep -rn "test-link coverage\|trailing" node_modules/@re-cinq/eslint-plugin-re-lint/dist/rules/require-status-matches-coverage.mjs | head -8

grep -rn "statementCoverage" node_modules/@re-cinq/eslint-plugin-re-lint/dist/ --include="*.mjs" -l | head -5; grep -n "testable\|\.test\.ts\|isTest\|trailing" $(grep -rln "export function statementCoverage\|const statementCoverage\|function statementCoverage" node_modules/@re-cinq/eslint-plugin-re-lint/dist/ --include="*.mjs" | head -1) | head -30
grep -n "beforeSession\|onError\|afterSession\|catch\|finally\|export function createChatOrchestrator\|export const createChatOrchestrator" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts | head -30
grep -n "createChatOrchestrator" src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts | head -3; grep -rn "beforeSession" CHANGELOG.md | head -5

node scripts/check-spec-links.mjs specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; echo "spec-links exit: $?"; node scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; echo "anchor-names exit: $?"

git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
fix(orchestrator): repair red build on beforeSession test

Build PromptBuilder with its real config shape, split the acceptance
test to one expect per test, and move each spec citation into its
statement's trailing parenthetical so the links count as coverage and
reach the tests they name.

Fixes re-cinq/HALEngine#94

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)" && git push origin HEAD
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main --no-edit 2>&1 | tail -3; git status -sb | head -2
